'''Penybont Football Club''' ({{langx|cy|Clwb Pêl-droed Penybont}}) is a [[Wales|Welsh]] [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Bridgend]] ({{Langx|cy|Pen-y-bont ar Ogwr}}), that plays in the {{Welsh football updater|Penybon}}. The club was formed in 2013, following the merger of [[Bridgend Town F.C.|Bridgend Town]] and [[Bryntirion Athletic F.C.|Bryntirion Athletic]]. Penybont play their home games at Bryntirion Park, currently known as ''The DragonBet Stadium'' for sponsorship reasons."}}
